acceptance_rules.decision: A distinct label-color acceptance result, conditional on all root/native/raw controls. Not old PixelGate PASS, not layout acceptance or automatic product adoption. Root original-image review remains required.
acceptance_rules.foreground13: For each R,G,B separately, candidate mean absolute error at frozen original13 foreground pixels toward fixed14 foreground mean must not exceed original13 error; at least one channel strictly improves. Exact float comparison,epsilon0. Preserve every channel, per-pixel error improvements/regressions/ties,max/mean and signed changes; no best-channel or aggregate-only decision.
acceptance_rules.full_frame_color: Report original13-to14 and candidate13-to14 normalized fullFrameRGBA errors and all improved/regressed/tied counts, without choosing alternate regions/intents/filters or declaring wholeUI equivalence.
acceptance_rules.samehost13: Require original ICC bytes/mode/scale/layout, raw RGBA Frame ROI outside fixed label rectangle exact (zero tolerance), entire Frame alpha exact, fixed background-strip raw RGBA exact; preserve full body/label/whole-window difference report.
acceptance_rules.samehost14: Require raw stored RGBA complete Frame ROI and embedded ICC bytes exact versus14 original. Whole-window difference reported separately.

candidate_context_requirements: Actual root source/binary/manifest bindings supplied after freeze; no invented candidate hash. Same actual candidate product binary on13/14 before permitted private-CFID signing normalization.

color_pipeline.full_frame_diagnostic: Normalize each native Frame ROI to sRGB8 first, preserve alpha. Only13 fixed integer2x2 Pillow RGBA BOX to709x616;14 unchanged1x. Premultiplied encoded-sRGB8 averaging, not linear-light; original window integer phase, no registration/fitting.
color_pipeline.native_foreground: Each source embedded RGB ICC to fixed sRGB8, alpha copied. Foreground comparison uses native13 fixed mask and native14 fixed target; no cross-scale glyph alignment.
color_pipeline.unsupported_profile: Stop raster color stage; no profile substitution/installation/alternate intent.

foreground_mask.background: Per native pixel row, per-channel median of the fixed glyph-free background strip in normalized sRGB8
foreground_mask.candidate_policy: Always reuse original13 mask; never select foreground from candidate
foreground_mask.selection_source: Only each original normalized native-scale reference label crop; once, then frozen as row runs
foreground_mask.target: Original14 masked foreground arithmetic mean in each RGB channel; retained raw/native/sRGB stats distinguish rendered foreground pixels from NSColor/style value
foreground_mask.zero_mask_policy: Stop; do not change threshold or region

roi_policy: Chosen from original references only before any candidate read. Body includes the full Caption split button and margin; label includes icon+Caption text but excludes menu/bezel. Never fit, translate, expand or choose a better region after candidate results.
